commentary: Today, DCE  iron ore futures conƟnued to decline, but the decrease narrowed. The most-traded I2505 contract closed at 747.5 yuan/mt, down 0.73% for the day. Some traders were reluctant to sell, while others sold at market prices. Steel mills restocked at low levels. Market transacƟons were moderate today. In Shandong, mainstream transacƟon prices for PB ﬁnes were around 750-753 yuan/mt, down 2-3 yuan/mt from yesterday; in Tangshan, PB ﬁnes transacƟon prices were 770 yuan/mt, unchanged from yesterday. Although today's SMM blast furnace operaƟng rate increased by 0.26 percentage points to 85.33%, and daily pig iron producƟon at 242 sample steel mills rose by 15,100 mt to 2.346 million mt  WoW, the macro senƟment remained bearish. Iron ore futures conƟnued to ﬂuctuate downward under pressure. In the short term, the market lacks new drivers, and pre-holiday restocking is progressing slowly. Ore prices are expected to conƟnue ﬂuctuaƟng downward in the near term.
